# Project files and units

`GET /projects/<name>/bundle` (`./ise bundle`, or Download project file in the project menu) is the whole project as one `.ise` file: its log (so history, versions and every change), its thumbnail and the files it imported. `POST /projects/import` (`./ise import x.ise`, Open a project file, or dropping it on the view) opens one as a new project. Use it to hand a design to someone outside the team; teammates sync instead.

The person chooses the unit lengths show and are typed in (Preferences, ⌘ ,): fields, dimensions and measurements follow it, and a bare number they type is in it. The engine always works in mm; you always give mm.
